features.method: Both colours; four-connected interior source regions with a solid core. At least 60% of each region must remain its original colour. Regions touching the border or its one-pixel neighbourhood, and tiny or thin classification fragments, are excluded. All observed pixels still enter the image-error measurement.

changes: Preserve routing priority when the lowest-error grid loses a feature and a worse grid is selected to retain it.
Allow the existing bounded repair tail for that same tradeoff.
Use the ordinary retry entry floor for simpler junction proposals, retaining their half-remaining MILP allowance.
Give interpolated ordinary probes at least one second, capped by their original routing allowance; existing feature-grid reservations are unchanged.

focusedAfterProbeFloor.remainingFailure: Original outline-star independent error 0.0085 failed the unchanged strict <0.0085 bound.

observedConcurrentWorkload.description: Three unrelated generator/robustness.mjs processes each used roughly 80–87% CPU; several clang processes also used substantial CPU during the first run. They were observed, not modified. This is a confound, not proof that each failure is caused by contention.
